TABLE.NAME: local_mcpbridge_token_scope
TABLE.COMMENT: Maps a bridged webservice token to the OAuth scope granted at the moment it was created, so webservice_mcp can enforce read/write permissions without needing to re-match against local_oauth2's own token table.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: The bridged token string, matching external_tokens.token.

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: The OAuth scope string granted at token-creation time, e.g. 'openid profile moodle_mcp_read'.
